say:4:1810428001:1.text: What on earth did Bantus do to him...?

choice_prompt:5:1810428001.text: What on earth did Bantus do to him...?

say:7:1810428004:1.text: Reynald used to work under me. He couldn't have forgotten my face.
say:7:1810428004:1.source_cn: 雷诺尔以前是我的下属，他不可能连我的样子都认不出。
say:7:1810428004:1.male: Reynald used to work under me. He couldn't have forgotten my face.
say:7:1810428004:1.female: Reynald used to work under me. He couldn't have forgotten my face.

say:8:1810428005:1.text: Unlike Thane, you understand exactly what's happening. Reynald's condition reminds you too much of Rain.
say:8:1810428005:1.source_cn: 瑟恩疑惑不解，你却早已有了答案：毕竟这幅情景，你已经见过了。
say:8:1810428005:1.male: Unlike Thane, you understand exactly what's happening. Reynald's condition reminds you too much of Rain.
say:8:1810428005:1.female: Unlike Thane, you understand exactly what's happening. Reynald's condition reminds you too much of Rain.

say:10:1810428006:1.text: How did I lose my memory? You always told me it was a side effect of becoming a Graveborn...
say:10:1810428006:1.source_cn: 那我为什么会失忆？以前你都说是因为我变成了亡灵……

say:11:1810428007:1.text: Your memory was erased so you would forget your former life and devote yourself entirely to Bantus.
say:11:1810428007:1.source_cn: 洗去记忆，遗忘生前的一切，才能更好地为班题斯效力。

choice_prompt:13:1810428007.text: Your memory was erased so you would forget your former life and devote yourself entirely to Bantus.
choice_prompt:13:1810428007.source_cn: 班题斯会洗去他们的记忆，令其遗忘生前的一切，才能更好地为帝国效力。

say:17:1810428009:1.text: The look in Thane's eyes makes it clear that he doesn't fully trust you yet.
say:17:1810428009:1.source_cn: 尽管瑟恩对你的信任有所增加，但那双锐利的眼眸表明，他并...
say:17:1810428009:1.male: The look in Thane's eyes makes it clear that he doesn't fully trust you yet.
say:17:1810428009:1.female: The look in Thane's eyes makes it clear that he doesn't fully trust you yet.

say:18:1810428010:1.text: As a gesture of goodwill, you tell him about a "patient" you met while working at the Repair House who suffered from a similar condition.
say:18:1810428010:1.source_cn: 你诚恳地表示，自己“打工”的修缮屋刚刚接收过类似的“病例”。
say:18:1810428010:1.male: As a gesture of goodwill, you tell him about a "patient" you met while working at the Repair House who suffered from a similar condition.
say:18:1810428010:1.female: As a gesture of goodwill, you tell him about a "patient" you met while working at the Repair House who suffered from a similar condition.

say:19:1810428011:1.text: <style="highlight">Soul cocoons</style>... The Bantus government is sick to the core.
say:19:1810428011:1.male: <style="highlight">Soul cocoons</style>... The Bantus government is sick to the core.
say:19:1810428011:1.female: <style="highlight">Soul cocoons</style>... The Bantus government is sick to the core.

say:20:1810428012:1.text: What I did earlier was reckless. From now on, none of them leaves until we find a way to restore their memories.
say:20:1810428012:1.source_cn: 刚才是我过于冲动。在找到恢复记忆的方法前，我不会再冒险...
say:20:1810428012:1.male: What I did earlier was reckless. From now on, none of them leaves until we find a way to restore their memories.
say:20:1810428012:1.female: What I did earlier was reckless. From now on, none of them leaves until we find a way to restore their memories.

say:21:1810428013:1.text: Let's move Reynald to a safe spot first.
say:21:1810428013:1.source_cn: 先把雷诺尔藏在安全的地方，再去别处探索。
say:21:1810428013:1.male: Let's move Reynald to a safe spot first.
say:21:1810428013:1.female: Let's move Reynald to a safe spot first.

say:22:1810428014:1.text: The person I'm looking for... is most likely here.
say:22:1810428014:1.source_cn: 我要找的人……很大概率就在这里。
say:22:1810428014:1.male: The person I'm looking for... is most likely here.
say:22:1810428014:1.female: The person I'm looking for... is most likely here.
